sentences.text: A current directly with you adds its drift to your speed, and one directly against you subtracts it, so ten knots against a two knot current makes eight over the ground.
A cross current needs a course correction into the current, found with the vector diagram.
Wind pushing the boat sideways, called leeway, acts just like a current.
And current predictions are only estimates, so keep taking fixes and adjusting your course to steer.
